source-markup.purpose: Define the canonical Compass source-file markup contract for authored code in this workspace. This document specifies the three-block contract (MODULE_CONTRACT, KEY_DECISIONS, CHANGE_SUMMARY), the inline invariant format, the forbidden set, the resolved scan policy, and the coverage modes — as enforced by `compass.validate`.

block.name: MODULE_CONTRACT
block.purpose: State what the file is for and what it must NOT do.

inner.name: purpose
inner.rule: At least 10 words (COMPASS-PURPOSE-01) and at least one standalone lowercase token derived from the file name or exported symbols (COMPASS-PURPOSE-02).

inner.name: non-goals
inner.rule: At least one `<item>` stating what the file must NOT do (COMPASS-CONTRACT-03).

block.name: KEY_DECISIONS
block.purpose: Record current-state design truths of the file — invariants, chosen mechanisms, forbidden approaches. Current truth, not history; rewritten in place when behavior changes.

inner.name: item
inner.rule: Required on medium/high riskClass files (COMPASS-KD-01), optional on low. 1–7 items (COMPASS-KD-04), each ≤ 20 words (COMPASS-KD-03). Items MUST NOT start with a governance-ID prefix (COMPASS-KD-05). Empty or TODO-only blocks are COMPASS-KD-02.

block.name: CHANGE_SUMMARY
block.purpose: Capture the latest COMPASS-relevant changes to the file, compressed.

inner.name: item
inner.rule: At most 5 `<item>` entries (COMPASS-CS-05), each carrying a governance ID matching the resolved idPattern (COMPASS-CS-06). The retained items are the 5 newest. An empty block is legal.

inner.name: history
inner.rule: Optional single `<history>` element: comma-separated governance IDs collapsed from older items — deduplicated, per-namespace ascending numeric order (COMPASS-CS-07). IDs only, no descriptions, no length cap.

block-order.rule: Blocks MUST appear in canonical order: MODULE_CONTRACT → KEY_DECISIONS → CHANGE_SUMMARY (COMPASS-ORDER-01).

rules.rule: Required for files with risk class `high` (blast-radius boundaries such as middleware, discovery/runtime cores, registries).
Keep invariants short, durable, and directly relevant to failure prevention.
Optional for non-high-risk files but encouraged when a non-obvious constraint exists.

forbidden.name: MODULE_MAP
forbidden.reason: Restates export names already visible in the code.

forbidden.name: responsibilities
forbidden.reason: Restates what the code does; purpose + non-goals carry the non-derivable signal.

forbidden.name: COMPASS_BLOCK
forbidden.reason: No downstream consumer; presence is a validation error.

scan-policy.source: resolveCompassPolicy — generic defaults → stack profile → bindings.compass

applies-to.item: Every authored, non-excluded source file under the resolved scan roots.

requirements.item: `MODULE_CONTRACT` with `<purpose>` (>= 10 words, >= 1 file-derived token) and at least one `<non-goals><item>`.
`KEY_DECISIONS` when the file's risk class is `medium` or `high`.
`CHANGE_SUMMARY` with at most 5 governance-ID items plus optional `<history>`.
`@ai-invariant` when the file's risk class is `high`.

applies-to.item: Files matched by `excludedPaths` or `ignoredDirs` — generated, vendored, fixture, or tool-owned surfaces.

requirements.item: No Compass markup required; presence of contract blocks is tolerated but not enforced.
